info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_SIM Swap Management API
info.description: The SIM Swap Management API streamlines the process for managing SIM card swaps within the telecommunications network. This endpoint allows authorized users to initiate SIM swaps efficiently, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption for customers. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and automated systems that handle user requests for SIM retrieval or replacement. By providing an intuitive interface for managing these operations, the API enhances customer experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a SIM swap process for a user. A SIM swap involves transferring a user's service from one SIM card to another, which can be requested under certain conditions such as loss or upgrade. Ensure that proper verification is handled before processing the request.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a SIM swap operation, which allows the user to replace their current SIM card with a new one, usually due to loss, theft, or upgrade. The body must contain the necessary information to process the swap successfully.
